{{Quote|Moff Nezzor's resounding victory at Ruan demonstrates the strength of the Empire and exposes the vulnerability of the Republic. Those who say our enemy has gained the upper hand in the galactic war must clearly recognize this day as proof that the Empire is stronger than it has ever been. The Republic is unable to defend its own worlds and her citizens tremble before the might of the Imperial fleet. Their defeat and eventual surrender is inevitable. All hail the Immortal Emperor.|Official press release from the office of the Imperial Minister of War|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Imperial forces '''attacked''' the Republic [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Ruan]] and conducted an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. Under the command of Moff [[Nezzor]], the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] devastated Ruan's agricultural production facilities and killed thousands of Republic civilians and personnel.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We need to push forward on several fronts. Reclaim some of the worlds we have lost to the Republic. Attack new worlds that have never before trembled before the might of Imperial power. I am sending a list of possible targets for analysis. Find where we can reap the most reward for our efforts.|Darth Marr|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
After a [[Mission to Ziost|bombing attack]] on the [[Orbital Defense Command Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Minister of Logistics]] [[Davidge]], the Minister was ordered by the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Marr]] to launch additional attacks to put the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] back on the offensive in the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Davidge was also ordered to make use of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nezzor]], whom Davidge believed was an unprofessional sociopath, and the Minister was forced to divert resources to Nezzor. The [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] learned of the upcoming attack on [[Ruan]] through a [[black cipher]], one of the Empire's secure encryption devices that they had recovered during the attack on Ziost, though [[Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] refused to send any aid to the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in order to conceal the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] possession of the cipher.<ref name="Annihilation" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Enemy casualties are estimated in the thousands, as an Imperial fleet under the command of Moff Nezzor unleashed an orbital bombardment that devastated production facilities on the surface. The Republic fleet in the area was destroyed, with enemy reinforcements arriving too late to affect the outcome of the battle.|An Imperial newscaster|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
Penetrating deep into Republic space, a fleet under Nezzor's command attacked Ruan&mdash;one of the agriworlds that supplied the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and a planet located in the [[Coruscant sector/Legends|same sector]] as Coruscant&mdash;and wiped out the Republic fleet in the area before conducting a brutal [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] by [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. The attack wiped out most of the production facilities on the surface and killed thousands of civilians in the process, scoring a major victory for the Empire.<ref name="Annihilation" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Where will they strike next? Jace&mdash;where?''"<br />"''Duro. They're going to hit the shipyards in thirty-six standard hours.|Theron Shan and Jace Malcom|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
Emboldened by his success, Nezzor would attempt to strike at the ship-producing world of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] not long afterwards, and the Imperial [[Ministry of War (Sith Empire)|Ministry of War]] used the battle in its propaganda campaigns in order to reassure the people of the Empire that they were not losing the war.<ref name="Annihilation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle at Ruan was first mentioned in Chapter 11 of the [[2012]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' when Darth Marr orders Minister Davidge to make use of Moff Nezzor, and [[Theron Shan]] watches news reports of the battle over a week later while infiltrating the Imperial outpost [[Reaver Station]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
